notes: «- ...-» glosses are left out; «أمرني عبد الرحمن بن أبزى أن أسأل» is the scene: he commands, he does not transmit, so he is not a link.
«فسألته» : the one asked, ابن عباس, answers, so he is the last link (rule 5).
«وعن ﴿والذين لا يدعون...﴾ قال نزلت في أهل الشرك» is a second remark with no transmitter of its own; not stored as a route.
